items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-06-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...with T. Ruchon over there. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, yeah. Yeah, with T. Ruchon over there.

ctx.x: Man, way back in, let me see. 19 what? 19... Run... Run 41, something like that. Uh-huh. Because I had that boy, what you call, playing with me, and then Steve, you know, Steve Angle. Steve Angle? Yeah, he was playing with me first head out there, you know what I mean? Yeah. And now that Steve, he pulled out and went, you know, so I got Emile to play.
That's the band on that photograph from that magazine. Yeah, yeah. Yeah, with T. Ruchon over there. Yeah, yeah. What time? Was that before World War II? Oh no.
Yeah. Before? No. Yeah, it was before, yeah. Yeah, it was. Was it before the Depression? Yeah, yeah, yeah, before the Depression. Sure, we used to play on the lake and everywhere.
